tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: The NFC North game of the day. Green Bay has won three straight to reach 4-2 and swept Detroit last season; the Lions are 3-2 coming off their bye and rested. The market backs the home favorite, and the fair number agrees, but the Packers' recent form is the reason this is a lean and not an edge — Green Bay's offense has heated up while Detroit's secondary has questions (Branch questionable). No true edge, but the lean is the rested home favorite.
games.title: NFC North Showdown
games.verdict: LEAN: Lions -3.5 — no true edge, but the lean is the rested home favorite with the fair number behind it.

games.take: This is the one game on today's card that clears our board bar: BetRivers is hanging Arizona +210 against a devigged Pinnacle fair of 32.8% (+191 at Pinnacle, +190/+188 at DraftKings/FanDuel) for +1.6% EV. Denver is the better team on paper at 4-2 and its defense travels, but its offense is sputtering at ~19 PPG, and Arizona's price is simply too long. Sunny and 80°F in Glendale, no weather angle. The board play and the lean are the same side here.
games.title: The Board Play
games.verdict: LEAN: Cardinals +210 — a real edge, not just a lean: BetRivers is ~20 cents soft of the sharp market.

games.take: Sunday Night Football: the undefeated 5-0 Chiefs at the 3-3 defending champions. Kenneth Walker III's return is the matchup to watch against a Seattle run defense that has gone 35 games without allowing a 100-yard rusher. Rain is in the Seattle forecast (41-44%) but nothing severe. The fair number backs the home team, yet laying points against an unbeaten Mahomes team is never comfortable — no true edge, but the lean is Seattle.
games.title: Sunday Night Football
games.verdict: LEAN: Seahawks -3 — no true edge, but the lean is the home favorite with the fair number and the run-defense matchup behind it.

games.take: The 6-0 49ers are the league's last unbeaten storyline on this slate, visiting a 2-4 Falcons team indoors in Atlanta, so weather is a non-factor. San Francisco is the better team and the fair number says so, but 2.5 points on the road against a team with nothing to lose is a thin margin — no true edge, but the lean is the unbeaten road favorite.
games.title: Unbeaten on the Road
games.verdict: LEAN: 49ers -2.5 — no true edge, but the lean is the 6-0 road favorite.

games.take: An AFC North swing game in Baltimore, dry and 64°F with no weather angle. The market makes Cincinnati a road favorite and the fair number backs the Bengals, but Baltimore's quarterback situation is the swing factor — if the Ravens get their starter back at full strength, this number looks different. No true edge, but the lean is the road favorite as priced.
games.title: AFC North Swing Game
games.verdict: LEAN: Bengals -3 — no true edge, but the lean is the road favorite with the fair number behind it.

games.take: Walker Kessler returns to Salt Lake City as a Laker, and the 2-0 Lakers visit a 1-1 Jazz team missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot), leaving Utah thin at center. Jake LaRavia is cleared for Los Angeles; Thiero and Carr remain out. Note the honesty check: the Lakers' moneyline price that cleared our scan (-210 at FanDuel) moved to -230 before post time, so it is NOT a board play — but the spread lean still goes with the 2-0 road favorite. No true edge on the spread, just the better team at a fair number.
games.title: Kessler's Return
games.verdict: LEAN: Lakers -6.5 — no true edge on the spread, but the lean is the 2-0 favorite against a Jazz team missing its starting center.

games.take: New York is the heaviest home favorite among the early NBA games, and the fair number is the widest on tonight's card — the market prices the Knicks as clearly the better team. Orlando has to prove it can win this kind of road game at Madison Square Garden. No true edge at 7.5 points, but the lean is the home favorite.
games.title: Knicks at the Garden
games.verdict: LEAN: Knicks -7.5 — no true edge, but the lean is the heavy home favorite.

games.take: The closest game on the NBA slate — a coin flip by the fair number, with Detroit a one-point road favorite. Neither team separates on the number, so this is a pure lean call: Detroit gets the nod as the slight favorite on the road, but there is no edge here and nobody should be surprised by either result.
games.title: Coin Flip in Philly
games.verdict: LEAN: Pistons -1 — no true edge, this is a coin flip, but the lean is the slight road favorite.
